DWD-SIG723BLK-630 stainless Steel Floor Mount Door Stop & Holder
AHI satin Stainless Steel door bumpers

text.description_html:
Wood and Glass Door Holder and Door Stop

Stainless steel with large black rubber bumper stop for use on doors up to 2" thick. Easy to install. Concealed mounting for a clean installation. For use on residential and commercial doors including glass doors.

Also available: All Stainless Glass Door Holder and Door Stop

Packaged with all necessary mounting hardware. Safe door hold open for glass doors.

Easy to operate. Simply pivot the end of the stop with your foot. The smaller rubber bumper will cradle the door holding it open. Kick it back when you want to close the door. Black rubber bumpers on both sides protect your doors.

Specifications for the DWD-SIG723BLK-630 Door Stop and Door Holder:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Rubber Bumper Height: 13/16" (21 mm)
  • Rubber Bumper Diameter: 1-1/4" (32 mm)
  • Total Length: 4" (102 mm)
  • Maximum Door Width: 2" (50 mm)

Sold Individually
